name: Overseas Students Ombudsman complaints
summary: Free, confidential complaint service for international students with problems at a private education provider.
key: There are free and confidential services to help international students make a complaint about their study experience.
who: International students on a student visa who are studying, previously studied or plan to study with a private provider (the page names VET courses)
how: Use the Make a complaint option on the Ombudsman website
catches: Usually use your provider's internal complaints process first
Category is the closest fit: free complaint service

evidence.quote: There are free and confidential services to help international students make a complaint about their study experience.
The Overseas Student team at the Commonwealth Ombudsman can look into complaints from international students who are currently studying, previously studied, or are planning to study a VET course
